rows.en: Now! Take them out!
I know you can do it.
It's dangerous like this!
Fall back!
rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'shanto shinasai', not a word. Sibling clips here are 'get out/flee'; read as a retreat order (taihi shinasai?).

rows.en: Find a way to recover!
No! How could this happen?!
See? That's what you get for not listening to me.
What are you doing?! Honestly!
Reinforcements. That's a relief.
Thank the reinforcements, okay?
Don't relax just because backup arrived.
It seems the mission was a success. Good work.
Well, I'd say you did fairly well, wouldn't you?
That's only natural. After all, I was the one supporting you.
Leave it to me.
You'll pay for this.
Don't mock me.
Roger.
Understood.
Yes!
Captain, you're not in good form.
rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'taichou no choushi' as 'taichou' (health); read as 'taichou, choushi ga yoku nai wa' (Captain, you're not doing well), matching the captain-in-trouble clips around it.

rows.en: Pull yourself together, Captain!
Please fall back, Captain.
Review the chain of command now!
The captain's been shot down?
Oh no... Captain!
As expected, you're not captain for nothing.
Keep it up like this.
Well done, Ichijyo.
Honestly! Take this seriously!
You worked hard too. Mostly at getting in your allies' way.
Sigh. I was a fool to expect anything from you.
Just so you know, you only survived through luck.
The operation succeeded. Return to base.
You did well too. Good work.
You made it back. I'm counting on you next time.
You always work so hard, you know.
Naturally, you'd make it a success.
Impressive! Keep this up next time too!
I knew you'd pull it off. I recognize your ability, after all.
When you get back, I'll treat you to tea to celebrate.
I was worried. Promise me you won't do anything more reckless.
Next time, do it a bit more properly.
Stop messing around and return quickly.
You actually made it back. I'm amazed.
Operation complete. Return at once.
Good work. You got back safely, right?
You did well. I'm counting on you next time too.
You're someone I can really rely on.
Keep it up from now on, too.
That operation was amazing. Impressive.
I expected it to succeed, with you there.
rows.notes: Transcript has a stray particle (mono o); read as 'mono, seikou suru to omotte ita wa'.

rows.en: I wasn't worried. I trust you, after all.
Let's go get something sweet to celebrate the success.
Delta One to Skull, Angel and Apollo Squadrons. Adjust course to 308 plus A15. In range in 30 seconds. Intercept formation.
Delta One to all units. A large battleship has appeared in Area 108. Its fighters are closing on this ship. Intercept at once!
Delta 1 to Skull 11. You're assigned to intercept the enemy battleship. Get to your post immediately.
It's a fold! This ship is about to fold!
Let's get out now!
Enemy aircraft detected. They're approaching low over the sea from Area 27, and appear to be the all-female Meltrandi.
Huh?!
Please give these lyrics to Minmay.
Right now, you're the only one who can get Minmay to sing.
This is Delta One. Roger.
This ship is currently engaged with aliens. This is not a drill. I repeat, this is not a drill.
VT-102, VT-102 at the launch spot. Why aren't you taking off?
rows.notes: Spot name garbled (tenjiki spot); 'launch spot' is a guess.

rows.en: Stop messing around! Take off immediately! This is war!
Gunsight 1 to all Valkyrie units. Form up in B formation and wipe out the ground enemies.
VT-102 should have crash-landed in the city a while ago.
All ships, begin ascent!
The gravity control system...
Salvaged parts, that's why.
rows.notes: Literal 'because you use things you picked up'; referent of the earlier complaint unknown.

rows.en: All ships, attention! All ships, attention! Preparing to fire main gun!
rows.notes: Whisper wrote wrong kanji for 'zenkan ni tsugu' (all ships, attention) and for 'shuhou' (main gun); read as the standard phrases.

rows.en: Five minutes to transformation start.
Three minutes to transformation start.
Main gun, fire!
I have an idea. Quickly gather the Destroids at the bow of the Daedalus.
rows.notes: Whisper spelled Daedalus as Daidarasu; name read as Daedalus.

rows.en: Daedalus Attack!
Lieutenant Ichijyo, armored equipment is not authorized except for special missions.
rows.notes: Whisper wrote the rank as shoui with odd kanji; read as a lieutenant-grade rank.

rows.en: Switch to channel D3.
